response.sql: WITH matched_data AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat), with_fractions AS (SELECT md.zoneref, md.insurstat, md.record_count, CAST(md.record_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) as fraction FROM matched_data md) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, record_count, fraction FROM with_fractions WHERE fraction >= COALESCE((SELECT MIN(fraction) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fraction FROM with_fractions WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10)), 0) OR insurstat IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN insurstat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, fraction DESC
